title: 2D Platformer Character Controller
tagline: A physics-based platformer controller with a state machine and the New Input System.
overview: A 2D character controller that applies forces to a `Rigidbody2D` for smooth movement, with every parameter exposed so it can be tuned to different gameplay styles.

highlights.title: State machine
highlights.text: Player actions are managed through explicit states.

highlights.title: Game feel
highlights.text: Techniques such as coyote time and input buffering.

learnings: Game-feel techniques (coyote time, input buffering) and the New Input System.
